title: Release resource gate and headless benchmark suite
cli_contract: mr-crabs-bench --suite release --workload <name> --json <path>  (exactly one run, fresh process)

status_vocabulary.measured: real numbers captured; may satisfy gates
status_vocabulary.blocked: not_measured with exact reason; can never satisfy a gate

measured_headless: ascii_10mb: 10 MiB deterministic ASCII feed throughput (payload pinned in corpus/replay/payloads.json)
unicode_10mb: 10 MiB deterministic mixed-Unicode (valid UTF-8) feed throughput
scrollback_1m: 1,000,000 x 'line\n' feed with paged/compressed storage; logical_lines must not lose a line
resize_storm: 256 resizes across 5 sizes with seeded 4 KiB feeds between
redraw_replay: 512-step deterministic replay with per-step frame-delta builds; p50/p95/p99 frame build ns
engines_1 / engines_10 / engines_50: N live terminal engines with settled compression
headless_idle: strict idle after a burst: zero redraw/animation requests, zero retained-capacity growth
headless_cache: retained render cache warm + identical-frame fast path without growth
pty_launch_to_prompt: real PTY shell (-i, cleared env, PS1 marker) to first prompt; child reaped, no leak
pty_echo: bounded 4 MiB PTY round-trip through /bin/stty raw -echo; /bin/cat; byte-verified
image_decode_stress: S7 kitty PNG decode + zlib inflate on pinned graphics-corpus fixtures

effects: S9 mr-crabs-effects EffectsModel over damaged frames under an explicit clock; frames_until_idle, frames_after_expiry == 0, retained_capacity with default config, disabled config must retain 0 bytes
search: S8 mr-crabs-history search_sync + SearchWorker over a 200,000-line deterministic history; matches == 201, lines_searched == 200,000, worker round trip
blocked_never_pass: gui_frame_time: not_measured - requires an authorized GUI render surface; headless bench never launches a GUI instance
window_redraw: not_measured - requires an authorized GUI render surface
strict_gui_idle: not_measured - requires an authorized GUI render surface
energy: not_measured - powermetrics requires root authorization and is not invoked

execution.runs_per_workload: 1 warmup + 5 isolated measured runs, each a fresh process invocation
execution.aggregation: median per numeric metric across the 5 runs; p50/p95/p99 with nearest-rank for latency metrics (wall_ns, launch_to_prompt_ns, frame build percentiles)
execution.oracle_comparison: only ascii_10mb, unicode_10mb, scrollback_1m; only when payload spec AND FNV-1a 64 equal the pinned corpus values; only against verification/baselines/oracle-baseline.json measured entries; otherwise comparison-ineligible and the gate fails closed
execution.no_weak_gates: oracle gates are unchanged: throughput >= baseline throughput_mib_s; max_rss <= baseline median_max_rss_bytes; peak footprint <= baseline median_peak_footprint_bytes

hard_gates: pty_launch_to_prompt / pty_echo: child_reaped == true and child_alive_after_reap == false (process leak fails)
headless_idle / headless_cache: idle_redraw_requests == 0, idle_animation_requests == 0, capacity_growth_bytes == 0 (cache growth fails)
blocked metrics stay visibly blocked in the gate output and can never satisfy a gate
test_defense: stats.rs: median odd/even and nearest-rank percentile tests mirror verification/corpus/replay/aggregate-math-fixture.json
payloads.rs: determinism (regenerate == identical), exact lengths, FNV-1a 64 pins, 96-byte prefix vectors, valid-UTF-8 invariant
release_gate.py --self-test: arithmetic fixture and payload pin regeneration (Python mirror of the generators)
payloads.rs: search_history_payload determinism and pinned match count (SEARCH_EXPECTED_MATCHES)
